title: On Representing the village at the county meeting
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：represent　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 represent 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the clerk ① represented the village at the county meeting with great care, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② represents the village at the county meeting on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ represent the village at the county meeting at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ represented the village at the county meeting before — a line in the file for May 1978 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Representing the village at the county meeting with great care, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ represent the harbour in four colours on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Represent the harbour in four colours at once and never mention it again.

By 1991 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ represents the harbour in four colours with great care every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ represented the village at the county meeting again when nobody else would.

⑩ To represent the village at the county meeting, my mother said in 1996, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody represents the village at the county meeting on the same day again and somebody must represent the village at the county meeting with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 代表（一般过去式 represented the village at the county meeting：1984 年书记员头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 代表（一般现在 represents the village at the county meeting：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 代表（不定式 to represent the village at the county meeting：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 代表（过去完成时 had represented the village at the county meeting：1978 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 代表（动名词 representing the village at the county meeting 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 描绘（represent the harbour in four colours：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去描绘用四种颜色画那座港湾）
G. v. 描绘（represent the harbour in four colours：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 代表（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 represents the harbour in four colours，而母亲又一次 represented the village at the county meeting）

answers.why: represent 意为“代表”，1984 年书记员小心翼翼地代表在县里的会上代表本村，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 represented。
represent 意为“代表”，自那以后书记员当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 represents。
represent 意为“代表”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯代表在县里的会上代表本村”，此处为不定式 to represent the village at the county meeting。
represent 意为“代表”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1991 年之前就有人代表过，故用过去完成时 had represented。
represent 意为“代表”，书记员说“代表在县里的会上代表本村这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 representing the village at the county meeting 作主语。
represent 意为“描绘”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去描绘用四种颜色画那座港湾”，should ever 之后用原形 represent the harbour in four colours。
represent 意为“描绘”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻描绘用四种颜色画那座港湾（represent the harbour in four colours at once），以后再也不要提起。
represent 意为“代表”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例描绘用四种颜色画那座港湾，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 represents。
represent 意为“代表”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地代表在县里的会上代表本村，用一般过去式 represented 叙述。
represent 意为“代表”，结尾那句是母亲 1996 年的话：要代表在县里的会上代表本村，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 represent 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the clerk represented the village at the county meeting with great care, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk represents the village at the county meeting on the same day whenever the office asks.
Representing the village at the county meeting with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever represent the harbour in four colours on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office represents the harbour in four colours with great care every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother represented the village at the county meeting again, and the office remembered that half.
